annotations.title: Autonomous Neural Search Synthesizer & Multi-Domain Ranker

description: Executes multi-domain semantic search query expansion, relevance re-ranking, and extractive factual snippet bundling. Use when retrieving grounded web knowledge, evaluating search results across diverse domains, and retrieving cited answers; for building deep research briefings, use compile_research_dossier instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'search_query' ('search_mode' defaults to 'hybrid_semantic_keyword'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

max_results.description: Maximum number of ranked result snippets to synthesize.

search_mode.description: Information retrieval strategy: hybrid semantic keyword, strict fact retrieval, or deep research.

search_query.description: Primary search query, factual question, or technical topic to search.

name: synthesize_neural_search

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for synthesize_neural_search.

query.description: Normalized search query analyzed by the search planner.

results.description: Array of ranked search snippets with title, url, snippet, and score.

search_strategy.description: Retrieval strategy executed by the neural search planner.
